text: The Urysohn lemma states that in a normal space:
choices: Every closed set is a zero-set
Disjoint closed sets can be separated by a continuous function [0,1]-valued
Every open cover has a finite subcover
Every sequence has a convergent subsequence
explanation: Urysohn: in a T₄ space, for disjoint closed A,B there exists f: X→[0,1] with f|_A=0 and f|_B=1.
